capabilities: Export notes to PDF, DOCX, or HTML in academic styles
Create new notes from style-specific export templates
Replace a note's content with a template while backing up the original
Rasterize embedded Canvas files to PNG in exports
Render inline and display LaTeX math via MathJax
extras: No telemetry, network requests, or accounts; some Obsidian Markdown features (footnotes, complex lists, remote images, SVG embeds) are not publication-ready per the limitations section.
motivation: The author says "If you like it and want to help a student, please donate to my ko-fi here," implying the plugin is aimed at students writing academic papers.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in export that applies academic citation and paper styles with proper formatting, title pages, and reference sections.
summary: Export plugin that turns Markdown notes into styled academic documents in APA, MLA, Chicago, IEEE, Harvard, or AMA formats as PDF, DOCX, or HTML.
